name: Adobe Enhance Speech
tagline: Adobe Enhance Speech is a free online tool that uses AI to make voice recordings sound as if they were recorded in a professional studio. It removes background noise, room reverb, and equalises speech frequencies automatically. Podcasters, educators, and remote workers use it to rescue poor-quality recordings.
